text:
Priya: Quick sync — product would like to lock scope for the new tier + priority-lane add-on before planning the sprint. Need clear launch criteria: revenue threshold, number of pilot customers, perf SLOs, and contract language for burst behavior.
Liam: Agree. Proposed minimal launch criteria: 3 pilot customers signed, 99th pct latency < 200ms on hosted for small requests, documented telemetry + regression tests, legal-approved SLA clause for burst credits.
Kai: Engineering concerns: priority-lane requires per-route QoS + rate-limiter change. ETA ~3 sprints for full rollout; can we ship opt-in beta for Dedicated earlier?
Priya: Beta for Dedicated sounds reasonable. We still need to decide pricing shape: flat monthly add-on vs usage-based credits. Customer asks skew toward credits (predictable tokens) but that increases billing complexity and support surface.
Marta: From sales: most pilots prefer a flat add-on for easy procurement and predictability. For enterprise we can offer credits. Also asking for explicit overage behavior in contracts.
Jordan: Legal draft idea: "priority-lane burst credits are consumed on a best-effort basis; Redwood reserves the right to throttle to preserve SLOs; overage billing applies after [X] credits or sustained excess for [Y] mins." Need input on X/Y and exact SLA numbers.
Liam: Tech input: we can set X = 1.5x reserved capacity as a default. Need ops guardrails (auto-fallback to standard lane) and visibility in Console: per-route credit usage + throttle events.
Priya: Proposed launch checklist: product doc + pricing page, canary with 1 pilot, runbook + rollback, legal clause, and instrumentation (per-route qps, tail latency, burst-credits-used). Owners: Priya (product) + Kai (eng). Target: end of quarter.
Marta: I'll surface to pilots — but they want sample contract language first. @Jordan can you post a draft by EOB Wed?
Jordan: Yep, will post a draft in this thread by Wed 5pm. @Kai can you confirm the early telemetry signals we can expose for the beta?
Kai: We can expose per-route qps, 95/99/99.9p latency, and a "burst-credits-used" metric. Needs a tiny SDK change to tag priority requests — will open PR next week.
Priya: Good. Next steps: Jordan + Kai + Marta to sync Tue AM. Priya will update the roadmap doc with the proposed launch criteria. If no objections by Thu, we mark for next sprint planning. :thumbsup:
pricing-bot: Snapshot: pilot-revenue-estimate: $45k/mo if flat add-on priced at $15k/mo per pilot.
